Vanessa —

Thanks for the forward. Below is a concise commercial and technical summary you can share with Maria + procurement. I also included recommended commit/discounting structure.

Summary (high level)
- Base dedicated reserved pool: priced per-GPU-equivalent (we price in 'rPU' units tying to throughput). For Acme's workload we recommend the "M" tier (8 rPUs) targeting ~250 qps steady / ~600 qps burst. Base list price for M (24-month commit): $120,000/month.

Isolation delta (single-tenant VPC + KMS + audit retention)
- Feature bundle (full single-tenant): dedicated compute hosts, siloed block storage, per-customer VPC, customer-managed KMS/HSM integration, immutable audit log exports (3yr) + SOC2 artifacts.
- Single-tenant premium: +22% on base dedicated list price (includes one-time isolation provisioning fee).
- Alternatively, a la carte: KMS/HSM integration +5%, immutable logs +7%, dedicated storage +8% (sums to similar range if all chosen).

Integration & one-time fees
- KMS/HSM integration: estimated 40-80 engineering hours (one-time professional services fee $18k–$36k depending on HSM vendor and API work).
- Audit log export pipeline + SIEM integration: 30–50 hours; one-time fee $12k–$20k.
- Isolation provisioning (network & HW scheduling): flat one-time $25k.

Discounting & commit structure
- 12-month commit: baseline pricing (no term discount).
- 24-month commit: 10% term discount on base dedicated list price.
- 36-month commit: 18% term discount on base dedicated list price.
- Prepay annual: additional 2% netting on total.
- Large commits (>= 16 rPUs): we can offer additional strategic discount; approvals required.

Effective example (M tier, 24-month)
- Base M 24m: $120,000/mo
- Single-tenant premium +22% = $146,400/mo
- 24m term discount 10% applied to base portion only -> effective = (base after 10% = $108,000) + premium ($38,400) = $146,400 total (premium remains additive in this model).
- Prepay annual would reduce ~2% on total invoice.

Notes from Rishi (technical) — pasted below for accuracy on sizing and operational considerations:
> - Recommended sizing: start M (8 rPUs) with autoscale headroom to L (16 rPUs) for burst windows. M handles ~240–280 qps for the target model mix; L needed for sustained 500+ qps.
> - Isolation ops: single-tenant mode requires dedicated host pools and changes to our scheduler; cost driver is lowered packing efficiency and dedicated storage.
> - Audit retention impact: longer immutable retention increases storage and retrieval costs; 3yr retention adds material storage/proxy costs and increases monthly delta.

Next steps
1) Vanessa: share this note with Maria and clarify whether Acme prefers full single-tenant bundle or the a la carte path.
2) If Acme signals >24m/>=16 rPU commit, we can propose a bespoke discount (requires Kimberly approval).
3) Schedule technical call 12/22 — Rishi to join for KMS/SIEM scoping.

If procurement pushes back on the 22% premium, we can propose:
- Reduce premium to 16% for a 36-month prepay, or
- Keep 22% but credit a portion back as a one-time implementation rebate tied to their signed commit.
